sentences.text: ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL) Shri Maulik Nanavati, the learned counsel has put an appearance on behalf of the respondent National Highway Authority of India.

1. It is pointed out by Shri Maulik Nanavati, learned counsel appearing for the respondent - National Highway Authority of India that only Special Civil Application No.10226 of 2023 pertains to an Baluben Somabhai Parmar vs The Competent Authority, Nhai on 9 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134726586/

sentences.text: 1 acquisition made by National Highway Authority of India and all other writ petitions pertain to acquisition for Dedicated Freight Corridor by the Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited.

entities.text: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The aforesaid writ petition is, therefore, de-linked and being decided separately.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/19689/2023 ORDER DATED: 09/11/2023 undefined 2.

The petitioners herein seek re-determination of compensation on the premise that they are entitled for compensation treating the area in question as "Rural Area" as defined in the Gujarat Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Gujarat Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The assertion in the writ petition is that the term "Rural Area" has been defined in the Rules, 2017 to mean any area except the area covered by any urban local bodies and cantonment board or "Developed Area" declared by the Government.
The contention is that the determination with regard to the area in question being the rural area has not been made at the time of determination of compensation.

The contention is thus that the award dated 05.09.2017 in LAQ/Vadodara-Mumbai Express way/Dodka Compensation Case No.7/2013 is to be modified by re- computation of the compensation qua the land of the writ petitioners by multiplying the market value as determined under Section 26(1) of the LARR, 2013 Act with a Factor 2 and applying all other statutory benefits as per the said Act including solatium and interest admissible on the marker rate as per 2013 Act.
3.

entities.text: LAQ/Vadodara-Mumbai Express way/Dodka Compensation Case No.7/2013
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned advocate Mr. Maulik Nanavati appearing for the respondent National Highway Authority of India would submit that the respondents have no objection to the re-determination of compensation, as prayed by the writ petitioners, but, in any case, the area in question falling in rural area within the meaning of 2017 Rules and application of Factor 2 in accordance with Section 26(1)
of the Act, 2013 is to be made by the competent authority.

4. As factual inquiry is required to be made, we are of the considered opinion that the matter be relegated to the competent authority - Special Land Acquisition Officer, National Highway Authority of India, Vadodara for fresh consideration.

entities.text: National Highway Authority of India, Vadodara
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/19689/2023 ORDER DATED: 09/11/2023 undefined determination to be made by the competent authority, all attending circumstances/factors are to be taken into consideration.
5. Notice be also provided to the respondent National Highway Authority of India whose representatives can participate in the process of re-determination.

6. Once that determination is made with regard to the area in question falling in the rural area,
necessary amendments/revision in the award dated 05.09.2017 shall be made by the competent authority for re-computation of the market value of the compensation and the benefits admissible thereon.
The entire exercise shall be completed within a period of three months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
7. With the above direction, the present Special Civil Application is disposed of.
Direct service is permitted.
